WITH combined AS (
    SELECT b.created_at AS time, a.pretty_name, (b.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 AS temp_f
    FROM tstats_thermometer a
    JOIN tstats_tstatlog b ON a.romid = b.romid_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT b.created_at AS time, a.pretty_name, b.temp_f
    FROM tstats_thermohygrometer a
    JOIN tstats_thermohygrostatlog b ON b.thermohygrometer_id = a.id_channel
),
in_window AS (
    SELECT time, pretty_name, temp_f FROM combined WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
),
-- Carries each device's value backward to the start of the visible
-- window (its most recent reading at/before the window start), so the
-- line doesn't start from nothing if the last real change predates
-- this window. Bounded to the last 48 hours before the window start --
-- without a bound this has to scan/sort the *entire* historical table
-- per device (years of legacy data), which is what was timing out.
-- ORDER BY qualifies combined.time explicitly -- without that, Postgres
-- resolves the bare "time" to this SELECT's own output alias (a
-- constant) instead of the real per-row timestamp, silently breaking
-- "most recent" into an arbitrary row.
backfilled_start AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pretty_name) $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, pretty_name, temp_f
    FROM combined
    WHERE time BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '48 hours' AND $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY pretty_name, combined.time DESC
),
-- Carries each device's value forward to now -- dedup (thermohygrometers)
-- means nothing gets logged again until the value actually changes.
-- Same bounded-lookback and combined.time qualification reasons as above.
forward_filled_now AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pretty_name) now()::timestamptz AS time, pretty_name, temp_f
    FROM combined
    WHERE time BETWEEN now() - interval '48 hours' AND now()
    ORDER BY pretty_name, combined.time DESC
),
all_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM in_window
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM backfilled_start
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM forward_filled_now
)
SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', time) AS time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Master Bedroom' THEN temp_f END) AS "Master Bedroom",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Gdn Clone' THEN temp_f END) AS "Gdn Clone",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Out SEbS 142°' THEN temp_f END) AS "Out SEbS 142°",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Gdn Near Res.' THEN temp_f END) AS "Gdn Near Res.",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Garage' THEN temp_f END) AS "Garage",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Main Attic' THEN temp_f END) AS "Main Attic",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Garage Attic' THEN temp_f END) AS "Garage Attic",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Jessica''s' THEN temp_f END) AS "Jessica's",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Gdn Veg' THEN temp_f END) AS "Gdn Veg",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Gdn Flower' THEN temp_f END) AS "Gdn Flower",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Kitchen' THEN temp_f END) AS "Kitchen",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Gdn Vent' THEN temp_f END) AS "Gdn Vent",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Clone' THEN temp_f END) AS "Clone",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Veg' THEN temp_f END) AS "Veg",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Flower' THEN temp_f END) AS "Flower",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Office' THEN temp_f END) AS "Office",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Outside Station' THEN temp_f END) AS "Outside Station",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Laundry Room' THEN temp_f END) AS "Laundry Room",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Acurite-Tower 5715' THEN temp_f END) AS "Acurite-Tower 5715",
    MAX(CASE WHEN pretty_name = 'Acurite-Tower 10196' THEN temp_f END) AS "Acurite-Tower 10196"
FROM all_rows
GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', time)
ORDER BY time;

WITH combined AS (
    SELECT b.created_at AS time, a.pretty_name, (b.primary_value * 9/5) + 32 AS temp_f
    FROM tstats_thermometer a JOIN tstats_tstatlog b ON a.romid = b.romid_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b.created_at AS time, a.pretty_name, b.temp_f
    FROM tstats_thermohygrometer a JOIN tstats_thermohygrostatlog b ON b.thermohygrometer_id = a.id_channel
),
latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pretty_name) pretty_name, temp_f, time
    FROM combined
    WHERE pretty_name IN ('Out SEbS 142°', 'Garage', 'Main Attic', 'Garage Attic', 'Outside Station', 'Acurite-Tower 5715', 'Acurite-Tower 10196')
    ORDER BY pretty_name, time DESC
),
range_stats AS (
    SELECT pretty_name, MAX(temp_f) AS high, MIN(temp_f) AS low
    FROM combined
    WHERE pretty_name IN ('Out SEbS 142°', 'Garage', 'Main Attic', 'Garage Attic', 'Outside Station', 'Acurite-Tower 5715', 'Acurite-Tower 10196') AND $__timeFilter(time)
    GROUP BY pretty_name
)
SELECT
    l.pretty_name AS "Zone",
    l.temp_f AS "Temp (°F)",
    r.high AS "High (°F)",
    r.low AS "Low (°F)",
    l.time AS "Last Reading"
FROM latest l
LEFT JOIN range_stats r ON r.pretty_name = l.pretty_name
ORDER BY l.pretty_name;

SELECT time, speed_mph, direction_deg
FROM (
    SELECT l.recorded_at AS time, l.speed_mph, l.direction_deg
    FROM anemometer_logs l
    JOIN anemometers a ON a.external_id = l.anemometer_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(l.recorded_at)

    UNION ALL

    -- Carries the value backward to the start of the visible window,
    -- per device -- the most recent log in the last 48 hours at/before
    -- the window start (bounded so this never has to scan this table's
    -- full history as it grows).
    (SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.anemometer_id) $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, l.speed_mph, l.direction_deg
    FROM anemometer_logs l
    WHERE l.recorded_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '48 hours' AND $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY l.anemometer_id, l.recorded_at DESC)

    UNION ALL

    -- Carries the current value forward to now, since dedup means no
    -- row is inserted again until the value actually changes.
    SELECT now() AS time, a.current_speed_mph AS speed_mph, a.current_direction_deg AS direction_deg
    FROM anemometers a
) sub
ORDER BY time;

WITH range_stats AS (
    SELECT anemometer_id,
        MAX(speed_mph) AS high_speed, MIN(speed_mph) AS low_speed,
        MAX(direction_deg) AS high_dir, MIN(direction_deg) AS low_dir
    FROM anemometer_logs
    WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
    GROUP BY anemometer_id
)
SELECT
    a.name AS "Sensor",
    a.current_speed_mph AS "Speed (mph)",
    r.high_speed AS "High Speed (mph)",
    r.low_speed AS "Low Speed (mph)",
    a.current_direction_deg AS "Direction (°)",
    r.high_dir AS "High Direction (°)",
    r.low_dir AS "Low Direction (°)"
FROM anemometers a
LEFT JOIN range_stats r ON r.anemometer_id = a.external_id
ORDER BY a.name;

SELECT time, lumens, uv_index
FROM (
    SELECT l.recorded_at AS time, l.lumens, l.uv_index
    FROM photo_uvmeter_logs l
    JOIN photo_uvmeters a ON a.external_id = l.photo_uvmeter_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(l.recorded_at)

    UNION ALL

    -- Carries the value backward to the start of the visible window,
    -- per device -- the most recent log in the last 48 hours at/before
    -- the window start (bounded so this never has to scan this table's
    -- full history as it grows).
    (SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.photo_uvmeter_id) $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, l.lumens, l.uv_index
    FROM photo_uvmeter_logs l
    WHERE l.recorded_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '48 hours' AND $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY l.photo_uvmeter_id, l.recorded_at DESC)

    UNION ALL

    -- Carries the current value forward to now, since dedup means no
    -- row is inserted again until the value actually changes.
    SELECT now() AS time, a.current_lumens AS lumens, a.current_uv_index AS uv_index
    FROM photo_uvmeters a
) sub
ORDER BY time;

WITH range_stats AS (
    SELECT photo_uvmeter_id,
        MAX(lumens) AS high_lumens, MIN(lumens) AS low_lumens,
        MAX(uv_index) AS high_uv, MIN(uv_index) AS low_uv
    FROM photo_uvmeter_logs
    WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
    GROUP BY photo_uvmeter_id
)
SELECT
    a.name AS "Sensor",
    a.current_lumens AS "Lumens",
    r.high_lumens AS "High Lumens",
    r.low_lumens AS "Low Lumens",
    a.current_uv_index AS "UV Index",
    r.high_uv AS "High UV Index",
    r.low_uv AS "Low UV Index"
FROM photo_uvmeters a
LEFT JOIN range_stats r ON r.photo_uvmeter_id = a.external_id
ORDER BY a.name;

SELECT time, rain_in
FROM (
    SELECT l.recorded_at AS time, l.rain_in
    FROM raingauge_logs l
    JOIN raingauges a ON a.external_id = l.raingauge_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(l.recorded_at)

    UNION ALL

    -- Carries the value backward to the start of the visible window,
    -- per device -- the most recent log in the last 48 hours at/before
    -- the window start (bounded so this never has to scan this table's
    -- full history as it grows).
    (SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.raingauge_id) $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, l.rain_in
    FROM raingauge_logs l
    WHERE l.recorded_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '48 hours' AND $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY l.raingauge_id, l.recorded_at DESC)

    UNION ALL

    -- Carries the current value forward to now, since dedup means no
    -- row is inserted again until the value actually changes.
    SELECT now() AS time, a.current_rain_in AS rain_in
    FROM raingauges a
) sub
ORDER BY time;

WITH range_stats AS (
    SELECT raingauge_id, MAX(rain_in) AS high, MIN(rain_in) AS low
    FROM raingauge_logs
    WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at)
    GROUP BY raingauge_id
)
SELECT
    a.name AS "Sensor",
    a.current_rain_in AS "Rain (in, accumulated)",
    r.high AS "High (in)",
    r.low AS "Low (in)"
FROM raingauges a
LEFT JOIN range_stats r ON r.raingauge_id = a.external_id
ORDER BY a.name;
